purpose: Machine-readable router for reconstructing edward321416-maker/build-manager state in a new ChatGPT, Claude or Codex session without replaying prior conversations. Routing only: every substantive fact lives in the canonical repository file referenced here, read at the current main.

snapshot.baseline_meaning: canonical B2 closure main used to build this bootstrap package; provenance only, not a permanent claim about the current main
staleness_rule: Always read the live main SHA yourself; never take current_main from this file.
Compare live main against baseline_main. A newer main is expected and normal, because publishing this package is itself a commit.
If they differ, do not treat this manifest as truth. Reconstruct from live main using Git ancestry, current STATUS.md, the newest acceptance receipts and current PR state.
Report which documents you found stale rather than silently trusting either side.

approved_specs.note: Canonicalized into main through closure PR #35 as a byte-identical copy of the PR #33 source. Read it from main; verify the sha256 either way.

frozen_decisions: PF00 toolchain and verification foundation are frozen.
PF02-A PostgreSQL foundation (schema, transaction/RLS boundary, ephemeral integration tests) is frozen.
B1 uses the Auth0 Database connection only for Web identity.
B1 authentication, session registry, proxy transport, session completion and logout are frozen.
B2 uses the approved A+ architecture, canonical in main.
Organization context is a separate capability from property authority.
ORG_ADMIN reads every ACTIVE property in their own ACTIVE organization.
PROPERTY_STAFF reads only properties with a current ACTIVE assignment to their current membership.
Existing /api/v2 URLs are reused; no staff-specific duplicate API.
No assignment mutation API or UI in B2.
Modular Monolith with explicit SQL and application ports; no ORM.

do_not_reopen_without_new_evidence.rule: Reopen a frozen decision only on new, specific, reproducible evidence: a demonstrated security or data-isolation defect, a contradiction proven against an exact ref, or an explicit operator instruction.
insufficient_reasons: a cleaner or more modern architecture
a general best-practice claim with no failing case in this repository
a wish to refactor or unify frozen code without adding verified behavior
do_not_reopen_without_new_evidence.required_action_if_suspected_defect: Report exact file, ref and failing scenario, then stop. Do not redesign first.

deferred_or_unauthorized: production DB hosting and credential/IAM provisioning
real tenant, landlord or address data (REAL_TENANT_DATA = NOT_AUTHORIZED)
assignment mutation API, UI or lifecycle
completion of privacy and security work

open_risks.note: B1 LOW findings and B2 B2I-L01..L04 remain non-blocking; read each receipt for current disposition.

ci_evidence.rule: Candidate, implementation-main and closure-main CI are distinct generations and are not interchangeable. A docs-only closure run is publication evidence, not product re-verification.

current_product_task.note: Do not propose a B3 scope, draft a roadmap or begin designing the next slice unprompted.

authority_order: conversation memory (lowest, never a source of truth)
exact Git ref readback from the current main
canonical acceptance receipts and STATUS.md at that ref (highest)

classes.EXECUTOR_LOCAL: Run on the executor machine; not independently reproduced.
classes.HOSTED_CI: GitHub Actions run; cite run id, head SHA and event.
classes.INDEPENDENT_REVIEW: Reviewer reading of a fixed ref; not a runtime claim.
classes.LIVE_PROVIDER: Real Auth0 interaction; currently executor-reported only.
classes.SYNTHETIC_AUTH: Test-minted session cookie, not a provider login.
classes.ACTUAL_WEB_POSTGRES: Real app server and real PostgreSQL with synthetic identity.

not_evidence: automated bot status such as CodeRabbit is not independent review
a green CI run is not an authorization-correctness proof
configuration present in a workflow file is not proof it executed
evidence_rules.historical_truth_rule: An acceptance receipt preserves the facts as of its own closure. A later milestone may change the current disposition of an item recorded there; B1I-M01 is open in the B1 receipt and CLOSED_BY_B2 now. That is succession, not contradiction. Never edit a past receipt to match current status; record the new disposition in the newer receipt and in STATUS.md.
contradiction_procedure: identify the exact refs and snapshot dates of both documents
check Git ancestry to see which state is actually reachable from main
prefer the canonical evidence at the newer exact ref
state explicitly which document is stale and why
do not silently edit either document as part of an unrelated task
